events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album "Imagine" was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Enduring Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, John Lennon released an album that still resonates globally. 'Imagine' – a powerful message then, and now.

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Musician Sting, born Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's Legacy
angles.copy: From The Police frontman to a stellar solo career, Sting is 75 today! What's your favourite track from the legendary artist?

events.title: The iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Before Streaming
angles.copy: Remember a world before streaming? 25 years ago, the original iPod dropped, changing how we listened to music forever.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Licence to Thrill
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and which film gets the top spot for you?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Actor and comedian John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as the "White Album," on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece or a collection of solo efforts? You decide.

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the death of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Forever a Champion
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost an icon. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Folk Rock Evolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, marking a pivotal moment in their sound. Still a favourite for many.

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On this day, we pause to remember John Lennon, 46 years since his passing. His musical and cultural impact lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music icon David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. A true chameleon of rock.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're still all shook up by the King, Elvis Presley.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! What's your favourite Led Zeppelin riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Legendary British singer Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Maggie May's Man
angles.copy: He's still got that distinctive rasp! Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart. What's your top Rod track?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's Birthday
angles.copy: Our House, in the middle of his 66th birthday! Happy Birthday to Suggs from Madness. What's your favourite track from the ska legends?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Wherever He Lays His Hat
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the blue-eyed soul legend, Paul Young! Still got 'Every Time You Go Away' on repeat?
